description: Change of use of a three-storey building comprising industrial space (Class B2) at ground and first floor levels to provide a three-storey office accommodation (Class B1a) at second-floor level accordance to planning application 233024OPDVAR to ground floor to continue use as (Class B2), first floor to be used as industrial catering business with ancillary storage and distribution (Class B8) and second floor Class B1a to E (b) Sale of food and drink for consumption (mostly) on the premises) (development right) Material amendment (S73) for relocation of toilets for shared use at the first floor, converting unused exterior terrace to internal space on the second floor and installation of rear windows on the second floor accordance to planning application 233024OPDVAR
